intro_zh: 先听完整课文，再按“伦敦地标 -> 历史假设 -> 得名和建造 -> 又大又准 -> 每天检查 -> BBC 广播钟声 -> 很少出错 -> 油漆桶拖慢指针”的故事线跟读。重点读清 Big Ben, B.B.C., Houses of Parliament, erected, Sir Benjamin Hall, immense, accurate, Greenwich Observatory, have the clock checked, rarely gone wrong 和 one of the hands。

sentences.text: When you visit London, one of the first things you will see is Big Ben, the famous clock which can be heard all over the world on the B.B.C.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：到伦敦时，最先看到的东西之一就是 Big Ben，这座著名大钟的声音可以通过 BBC 被全世界听到。长句先停在 London，再读 one of the first things，最后把 which can be heard 当作补充说明。

sentences.text: If the Houses of Parliament had not been burned down in 1834, the great clock would never have been erected.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：如果国会大厦没有在 1834 年被烧毁，这座大钟就永远不会被建起来。读清 had not been burned down 和 would never have been erected，这是过去反事实。

sentences.text: Big Ben takes its name from Sir Benjamin Hall who was responsible for the making of the clock when the new Houses of Parliament were being built.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：Big Ben 得名于 Sir Benjamin Hall，他在新国会大厦建造时负责造钟。长句分成 takes its name from、who was responsible for、when ... were being built 三段。

sentences.text: It is not only of immense size, but is extremely accurate as well.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：它不仅体型巨大，而且也非常准确。not only 和 but ... as well 配对，immense 和 accurate 都要读得清楚有力。

sentences.text: Officials from Greenwich Observatory have the clock checked twice a day.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：Greenwich Observatory 的官员安排每天两次检查这座钟。have the clock checked 是“安排检查”，不是“拥有一个被检查的钟”。

sentences.text: On the B.B.C. you can hear the clock when it is actually striking because microphones are connected to the clock tower.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：当大钟真正打点时，你可以在 BBC 上听到它，因为麦克风连接到了钟塔。when it is actually striking 说明听到的是打点声，are connected to 是被动连接。

sentences.text: Big Ben has rarely gone wrong.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：Big Ben 很少出错。rarely 是“很少”，这一句要短而准，不能读成经常出错的意思。

sentences.text: A painter who had been working on the tower hung a pot of paint on one of the hands and slowed it down!
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：一个在塔上工作的油漆工把一桶油漆挂在一根指针上，把它拖慢了。one of the hands 是钟表指针，不是人的手；slowed it down 是笑点落点。
